title: 🟢 Balanced Partition
description: Partitions nodes around 3 while preserving the relative order within both groups.

title: 🚦 Simple Partition
description: Moves the node smaller than 2 before the node greater than or equal to 2.

title: 📭 Empty List
description: An empty linked list remains empty regardless of the partition value.

title: 🟢 Everything Smaller
description: All nodes are smaller than x, so the original list remains unchanged.

title: 🔵 Everything Greater
description: All nodes are greater than or equal to x, so their original order is preserved.

title: ⚖️ Equal Values
description: Nodes equal to x belong to the second partition and retain their relative order.

title: 🔒 Stable Ordering
description: Both partitions preserve the original ordering of their nodes.

title: ➖ Negative Values
description: Negative nodes are placed before non-negative nodes while preserving their order.

title: 🎯 Negative Pivot
description: Partitions a list using a negative value while maintaining stable ordering.

title: 🔄 Interleaved Values
description: Separates alternating smaller and larger values without sorting either partition.

title: 📏 Single Node
description: A single node equal to x remains in the greater-than-or-equal partition.

title: 🔢 Duplicate Smaller Values
description: When every node is smaller than x, duplicates retain their original positions.
